The '''Union Sentry Droid''', abbreviated '''USD''',<ref name="GU12ET">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68375&month=072009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Game Update 12 -- Engineering Trader}}</ref> was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] developed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SWG:USD" /> This six-legged droid<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> was primarily designed for use on worlds with rugged terrains where other droids would have difficulties in moving efficiently. The USD proved to be a worthy war machine but was only used for a short time since it was developed towards the end of the war.<ref name="SWG:USD" /> Two decades later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-47]] reactivated the production of Union Sentry Droids in the [[Neimoidian droid factory]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] as part of his plan to create a [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]].<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />

Variants of the Union Sentry Droid included [[GK-5 sentry droid|GK-5 Sentries]], the [[USD Class Pulverizer]], the [[Doom Bringer]] and its [[Hand of doom|hands of doom]],<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> [[GK-14 Defender]]s, [[GK-18 Sentinel]]s and the [[GK Oppressor]].<ref name="SWG:DH">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Destroy HK-47|Mustafar}}</ref>
{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Union Sentry Droid appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Union Sentry Droid was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />
